10000.Tips:
In the beginning, Esperia was in complete chaos. Dura used the core elements to forge the world we have today. It took Dura five days to create the world, and on each day, she created one elemental guardian, each one responsible for keeping their own element in check.
 
 On the first <Day>, she created Aaldir, Guardian of Earth, who rose from the ground.
 
 On the second <Night> she created Udea, Guardian of Water, who was born from the waves. 
 On the third <Day> She created Zateus, Guardian of Fire, born from the flowing magma of the Scalding Peaks. 
 On the fourth <Day> she created Elo, Guardian of Wood.
 On the fifth and final <Day> she created Winas, Guardian of Wind.

130114.Tips:
"knock knock knock."
At the boundary of the living and the dead, the spirit who'd lost every memory finally knocks on the wooden door of that small, run-down house. The door opens a slight crack, the small pallid face of a girl peering out.
"Didn't I tell you? You shouldn't come to my home tonight making trouble." He merely listened to his daughters grumblings, "I saved all the candy in the house for daddy, tonight is Noctis Animarum, daddy will definitely come visit me."
Looking at the girl's face, the spirit felt a sense of familiarity in that timid, loveable countenance, as if feeling a deep love. If only he could remember the name...
Wait!
He remembered! He remembered everything! This was once his home, and before his very eyes stood his beloved daughter, of whom his thoughts never strayed from!

130115.Tips:
Elijah looked at the father and daughter locked in a tight embrace and turned to Lailah beside him,
"Is that it? Are their souls free now?"
"Yes. Their souls are entwined, having relied upon familial obsession to find one another, they can never again be parted." Lailah turned to Elijah and asked, "do you still feel that helplessness you felt before?"
"I do, their souls were so pure, they... deserved a better end." Elijah bowed his head, his hair falling over his face, "Is there more we could be doing? Could we act sooner, prevent tragedy from occurring at all?
"My brother, the answer is still the same - we are not omnipotent, we can only do our best."
The Celestial Twins fly up into the sky, towards the strange and unfathomable Realm of Denial. They shan't rest until sunrise, for tonight, they have a great deal of work to do.
Noctis Animarum, when wandering souls return home. The greatest and rarest thing in all the world, is the reunion of souls.

This place appears be dark and polluted. A constant mist sits heavy on the ground, refusing to disperse.

134011.Tips:
First Aspiration

Father still isn't here. I thought he'd be back for my birthday this year.
Adults never keep their promises, yet always want kids to tell the truth.

134013.Tips:
Second Aspiration

He always gets his own way.
No matter what my older brother does, father always supports him. Every time I want to do something I'm ignored or refused.
Father doesn't have faith in me. I'll start my own business.
I know not everyone is as gifted as my brother. I know a lot of people still haven't found their calling, many people feel lost.
Perhaps I'm just one of those lucky people, born into money but without the natural talents of my brother. Father must be disappointed in me.

134015.Tips:
Third Aspiration

No wonder Father looks down on me. I've lost my identity. I can only depend on myself now. It sure is hard making new friends.
Successful folk look down upon me for my wealth, for I did not earn it myself. Regular folk just want to befriend me for my wealth.

These types of friends aren't real friends. They're no better than... than a duck.

134017.Tips:
Fourth Aspiration

Marriage is such a big occasion. Father never bothered to ask me what I thought about it. It would seem I am not indispensable after all. Am I really his child?
And to marry someone I've never even met? Ridiculous!
I don't even know who I'm marrying. Who knows if they'll even like me? I cannot allow this marriage to take place. I need to run away from this place.

134019.Tips:
Fifth Aspiration

Money is the most magical thing in the world.
One day I'll surpass Father. I'll be much richer and more famous than him!
Since money is the measure of our success, I'll make a thousand times what he has! Then we'll see if he still looks down upon me!
I'll build more factories than him, I'll build better machinery than his! I'll do business throughout the whole world. From the snowy mountain peaks down to the Dark Forest! I'll harvest it all!

134021.Tips:
Sixth Aspiration

These Wilders have all this land but don't understand its true value! They're definitely not entrepreneurs!
Trees and rivers... how could they possibly compare to money?
I know for a fact there are vast resources at the edge of the Dark Forest. Lots of resources to be harvested. I've already got some great plans in mind for that land.
In order to maximize my profits, some minor sacrifices may be needed, but any sane person would understand my reasons.
Once the assembly line is finished and the machine is ready to go, I'll be filthy rich!
There's nothing wrong with making money! Gold... I need more gold. I want to swim in gold!

4003026.Tips: The annual anniversary of the Hypogean War is approaching. In the year of 74, the Goddess Dura sealed the Hypogeans behind The Barred Gate, signaling triumph and the end of the first Hypogean War. During the long war, the people of the Lightbearer Empire rallied together and eventually succeeded in defeating the threat, defending their homeland. It is the crowning glory of every citizen. The land beneath our feet is soaked with the blood and hopes of our ancestors, and the glory of the past should be remembered, while the historic fight against evil should never be forgotten. While making merry, please spare a moment to remember those who sacrificed everything to defend their homes, and remember that the Hypogean threat is never far away. It is our duty to be vigilant against any evil, and to protect the beauty of life that has been hard-won.

4003027.Tips: ...When the time comes, apparel from the Rayne Family will be put on display at the banquet. This apparel belonged to the founder of the Rayne family and former commander of the Guardians of Dawn, Kheiss Rayne. He wore this attire when attending the very first banquet to celebrate the victory of the First Hypogean War. It testifies the achievements and contributions of the family's fight against Hypogeans, and is a symbol of the eternal glory of humanity over the Hypogeans. It conveys Kheiss Rayne's will, and inspires us all to move bravely forward into the new era.

4003028.Tips: Breaking news! The Rayne Family's precious apparel has been stolen during the banquet! It is reported that the thief took advantage of lax security to steal the apparel, and the guards involved have been severely disciplined. The last person to touch the apparel, the maid Rosaline, has been taken into custody. However, the whereabouts of the apparel remains unknown. The Lord of the City, Prince Lester, has issued a public notice offering a handsome reward for information on its whereabouts.
